title: Sub-psi refinement of the VALVE-179 safety cliff and its physical mechanism

env.determinism: EPANET's hydraulic solver is deterministic. No stochastic input is used anywhere in Phase 5; leak-node selection and leak-coefficient allocation are closed-form functions of pipe length, so no random seed is required. Recorded seed: none used.

scope_statement: Characterisation only. The grid was fixed before execution. No optimisation, no search, no reward, no RL. Native controls, rules and topology untouched in every run.
